query: Which unbiased genome-integrity assays (shallow short-read WGS, long-read sequencing, optical mapping) and decision thresholds should we commit to for off-target and structural-variant detection?

response.query: Which unbiased genome-integrity assays (shallow short-read WGS, long-read sequencing, optical mapping) and decision thresholds should we commit to for off-target and structural-variant detection?
response.answer: For unbiased genome-integrity assays, shallow short-read WGS and long-read sequencing are recommended. Decision thresholds depend on specific detection sensitivity and error rates. Consult recent genomic standards for precise thresholds.
